_readme: The education gate — the question an advisor is asked, before any recommendation, when the engine can see a client is not comfortable reading their own numbers. Item 2.9. Behaviour ruled by Mike 2026-07-16, reach ruled 2026-08-16, wording ruled 2026-08-24. Design: design/EDUCATION-GATE.md. Artefact: design/mockups/education-gate.html. This file is the PLATFORM DEFAULT; each tier's overlay is merged over it (mentor -> global -> group -> firm) exactly the way data/ai-prompts.json is. `_`-prefixed keys are documentation and are stripped before anything reaches an API response or a model.
_wordingNote: 🔴 THE WORDING IS MIKE'S, APPROVED VERBATIM 2026-08-24 from three drafts shown side by side. He chose this one because it makes clear the advisor keeps the teaching either way — the gate advises, it never takes the judgement off the advisor. Do not 'improve' it here; change it on the mentor screen, which is what the screen is for.
question:
From what you've described, this client may not yet be comfortable reading their own numbers.

Do you want me to put education first, or show what's technically needed and leave the teaching to you?

options.label: Education first
options._effect: Sets the sequencing rule to education_first — the same rule the `education` engagement type sets. Not editable: the label is wording, what it does is fixed.
options.acknowledgement: Education first. I'll lead with the material that builds the client's understanding, then the technical work.

options.label: What's technically needed
options._effect: Leaves sequencing at standard. The teaching stays with the advisor.
options.acknowledgement: Straight to what's technically needed. I'll show the technical recommendation and leave the teaching to you.

_reasonNote: 🔴 REQUIRED BY THE 2026-07-16 RULING — 'the reasoning shown either way'. This sentence is appended to the acknowledgement whichever option is chosen. {phrase} is the matched trigger text. If no phrase can be named the WHOLE sentence is dropped rather than softened: a gate that cannot say why it fired should say nothing, not something woolly. See design/EDUCATION-GATE.md §4.
reason: This came up because you mentioned "{phrase}".
_phrasesNote: Merged over the patterns in data/signal-dictionary.json -> gateSignals.financial_literacy_gap. These are PLAIN PHRASES, not regular expressions — a mentor types what an advisor would say, and matching is literal and case-insensitive. The regex patterns in the dictionary stay in the dictionary, where a developer maintains them; this list is what a non-developer adds to. Seeded from pd-35's six authored triggers in data/advisory-distinctions.json so the two cannot start from different words.
